reviews.title: Ai generated app probably
reviews.text:
this is probably one of those apps that is generated by AI like base 44. you can tell because there’s a clear lack of human touch in it. 

There's no undo button if you don’t like the way it edited a photo. It will detect faces in a photo, and then pick the first one to sharpen, rather than letting you pick. And then it does it badly a lot of times and turns faces into a completely different person.  

having AI make an app is one thing, but if you don’t go over it and smooth out the details and ensure it is user-friendly, it’s just not gonna be great.

reviews.title: Barely any Color
reviews.text: I tried a yearbook picture, but color was weak and washed out. I’ll be getting a refund.

reviews.title: Awful colours
reviews.text: I tried it on images I already knew the colours of and they were awful!

reviews.title: Deceptive scam
reviews.text: I thought for sure that I canceled my membership immediately after signing up for a free trial so I could colorize ONE photo of my aunt from her high school yearbook. I was just scanning my transactions from the last month and discovered I was billed $29.99 for a membership through December 2026. Extremely disappointing, buyer beware!

reviews.title: Hard to select photos
reviews.text: Once downloaded there seems to be no way or option to open photos on device to colorize. Only the initial photo I processed is showing

reviews.title: Changed
reviews.text: Used to be able to download photos. Unable to do that now.
